cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: C1 ether-sulfate chassis with exactly one prominent buffer and no prominent reinforcing route. Defining anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate (2); buffer Cocamidopropyl Betaine (4); E3 point = Parfum (7). Sodium Xylenesulfonate (3) is a hydrotrope (C3, not a route). TEA-Dodecylbenzenesulfonate (18) is a strong sulfonate but listed after Parfum, so recorded only (C4). Counter-signal toward strong: single buffer plus a second (non-prominent) strong anionic; no refatting. Confidence moderate because the only thing holding the C1 convention at moderate is one buffer of unknown level; neighbor strong (N-ALT).

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: one meaningful silicone/cationic-guar deposition system: Dimethiconol (10), Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride (11), Dimethicone (14), plus Panthenol (19). All conditioning routes sit after Parfum (7), so C2 is not met (no early silicone, no pearlizing/fatty route). Counter-signal: post-fragrance positions only -> realistic neighbor low.

depositionLoad.rationale: Two silicones plus a cationic guar form a classic coacervate deposition system; all after Parfum, so not a rich load.

persistence.rationale: Dimethicone/dimethiconol are persistent and can accumulate with repeated use; no lipid or film former reinforces them.

resetCapacity.rationale: SLES with one betaine buffer, plus a late sulfonate; effective ordinary reset, not clarifying.

weightPotential.counterEvidence: All deposition routes are post-fragrance; no payload lipid, no second polymer, no W-RICH. Argues toward low.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: A silicone/guar coacervate system is plausible enough to leave noticeable but bounded residue; moderate reset bounds it (W2: two deposition families judged as one system).
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not low: two distinct deposition families (silicone + cationic polymer) converge and silicones are persistent, so calling it lightweight would understate residue risk (W2). Not high: no rich architecture (W-RICH), no third converging family, effective sulfate/betaine reset; by analogy to W1 (silicone/guar set on a buffered sulfate chassis = moderate) the heavier band is less realistic.
weightPotential.limitingFactor: INCI order only; silicone levels and guar charge density unknown; W1 does not strictly apply (no amodimethicone), so the full 6.6 method decided.
